outcome.answer: Yes. Reifying each fact as a node and using a fixed vocabulary allows textbook GNNs, including an off-the-shelf GAT, to transfer zero-shot to unseen knowledge graphs; the best GAT matches a dedicated knowledge-graph foundation model on its evaluation suite [1]. This result shows that standard GNNs can do so with the proposed representation, rather than establishing that they work on unknown graphs without any adaptation to the representation [1].
